title.zh: 存储的双组分 SI 流体输入表

summary: Return an independent copy of the packaged ten-column two-species fluid input table.

capability: Return an independent copy of the packaged ten-column two-species fluid input table.
operation: read the packaged two-species fluid deck
no inputs -> packaged ten-column two-species fluid deck
discovery.geometry: Uniform background, zero drift and zero density gradient.
discovery.boundary: Declared local equilibrium input; no solution is inferred.

identity.relation: Packaged fluid input data to an SI fluid deck
identity.definition: Read the literal two-species ten-column fluid table without changing its physical numbers.
identity.geometry: Uniform background, zero drift and zero density gradient.
identity.boundary: Declared local equilibrium input; no solution is inferred.
assumptions: The table contains isotropic sound speeds per species.

Fluid constants profile: c2=(2.9979e8 m/s)^2, epsilon0=8.854e-12 F/m, mu0=1/(c2*epsilon0), gamma default5/3. Charge and mass are explicit SI deck inputs; packaged defaults use q=+/-1.602e-19 C, me=9.109e-31 kg and mp=1.673e-27 kg. Sound speeds are direct inputs; no kB or temperature-to-speed conversion is performed. This is distinct from current kinetic initialization epsilon0=8.8542e-12 F/m.

outputs.name: deck
outputs.units: C; kg; m^-3; m/s; m/s; m/s; m/s; m/s; m^-1; m^-1
outputs.constraints: Literal table: density 8.7e6 m^-3 per species; the declared physical constants and sound speeds are used as given.

preconditions: Finite inputs satisfying the declared units and shapes.
supported: Package-local input data; no checkout or network.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError or a missing required mapping key rejects invalid inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency, numerical-library, or native-runtime errors propagate; no silent alternate provider.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result is returned on failure.

example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.dispersion.multifluid import fluid_deck
a, b = fluid_deck(), fluid_deck()
assert a.shape == (2, 10)
assert a is not b
example.expected: The packaged helper returned an independent float64 deck of shape (2,10); two calls returned distinct arrays with equal values.
